question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge (*6) at Outfall 001, does this permit row establish (a) report-only effluent limitations with no enforceable numeric discharge limit for any averaging period, and (b) a monitoring obligation of one 12-hour composite sample per week with results reported as the geometric mean of weekly values?
required_context: The effluent limitations table row for Total Dissolved Solids, Discharge (*6) showing Report/N/A in all limit columns, 1/Week measurement frequency, and 12-Hour Composite sample type
Footnote (*6): Total dissolved solids measured at Outfall 001; report the geometric mean value of weekly values
Adjacent TDS rows (Water Plants Intake (*7) and Net Increase (*8)) that pair report-only discharge/intake measurements with separately stated numeric net-increase limits
notes: Interpretation of whether the Report entries constitute enforceable numeric limits (Purpose A), what monitoring is required (Purpose B), and whether numeric compliance comparison is inapplicable for reported TDS discharge values (Purpose C) all hinge on how this row and footnote (*6) are read.
